info.title: Lingara events
info.description: The events Lingara sends about your account, to a webhook endpoint you register or through the event feed and stream, and the events your game or integration can send to Lingara. Every outbound event is the same envelope on every transport.

api.description: The Lingara API, which serves the event feed and stream and accepts inbound events.

receiver.description: Your own HTTPS endpoint, registered as a webhook endpoint.

webhook.description: Events delivered to a webhook endpoint you register: one `POST` per event, to your own URL.

feed.description: Events read page by page from `GET /v1/events`, oldest first.

stream.description: Events pushed as they happen over `GET /v1/events/stream`, a server-sent event stream.

inbound.description: Events your game or integration sends to Lingara with `POST /v1/events`.

app.description: Requests Lingara sends to your app's `render_url` for a card to draw, each signed with your app's `lgr_whsec_` secret as a webhook delivery is, and the card your app replies with.

receiveWorldContextChanged.description: Lingara records a `world.context_changed` event sent with `POST /v1/events`. With `generate: true` it also starts a lesson plan, which needs `lesson_plans:write`.

receiveWorldPracticeRequested.description: Lingara records a `world.practice_requested` event sent with `POST /v1/events` and starts a lesson plan for it unless `generate` is `false`. The plan needs `lesson_plans:write`.

receiveWorldPracticeCompleted.description: Lingara records a `world.practice_completed` event sent with `POST /v1/events` for a lesson plan the learner owns, and sends you `practice.completed` with the same items.

LessonPlanReady.name: lesson_plan.ready
LessonPlanReady.description: A lesson plan is ready to use. It fires at most twice for one plan: when the plan is first usable, with `status` `partial` or `complete`, and again if a `partial` plan is later completed.

LessonPlanFailed.name: lesson_plan.failed
LessonPlanFailed.description: A lesson plan could not be generated. `reason` is `generation_failed` or `timed_out`.

UsageThresholdReached.name: usage.threshold_reached
UsageThresholdReached.description: A metered account or client has used a share of its monthly spend cap. Only the highest threshold crossed is reported, so usage that jumps from 40% to 95% sends one event with `threshold_pct` `90`. An integration billed from an allowance never receives it.

WebhookTest.name: webhook.test
WebhookTest.description: A test event, sent to one webhook endpoint when you ask for it. It never appears in the feed or the stream.

AppInstalled.name: app.installed
AppInstalled.description: A learner installed your app. Only your app's own client receives it, never another client of the same account. `context` lists what the learner agreed your app may be shown.

AppUninstalled.name: app.uninstalled
AppUninstalled.description: A learner removed your app. Only your app's own client receives it. Stop using anything you kept for this install.

AppDisabled.name: app.disabled
AppDisabled.description: A learner paused your app. Only your app's own client receives it. If they installed it by granting access, then until they resume it your client's access tokens for this learner answer `403 app_disabled` and you hear no other event about them. `app.enabled` tells you when they resume.

AppEnabled.name: app.enabled
AppEnabled.description: A learner resumed your app. Only your app's own client receives it. Its existing tokens work again; no new consent is needed.

WorldContextChanged.name: world.context_changed
WorldContextChanged.description: Your game tells Lingara that the learner's world has changed.

data.scene: A night market in Taipei, just after rain

npc.name: Auntie Lin
npc.persona: a street-food vendor who likes to haggle

WorldPracticeRequested.name: world.practice_requested
WorldPracticeRequested.description: Your game asks Lingara for practice that fits the learner's world.

WorldPracticeCompleted.name: world.practice_completed
WorldPracticeCompleted.description: Your game tells Lingara which practice items a learner finished, and how each went.

PracticeCompleted.name: practice.completed
PracticeCompleted.description: A learner finished practice items in your game or site, with the outcome of each.

AppRender.name: app.render
AppRender.description: Lingara asks your app for a card to draw in a slot. `context` holds only what the learner agreed your app may be shown.

AppAction.name: app.action
AppAction.description: The learner pressed a button on your card. `action_id` is the button's `action`; `card_etag` names the card they saw and is not for verifying.

AppCard.name: app.card
AppCard.description: Your app's reply to either request: a card built from eight element types, and an optional note for the learner's tutor. Reply within 3 seconds to a render and 5 to an action, with status `200` and at most 32 KiB of `application/json`.

payload.tutor_note: The learner is practising 漢字 from their JLPT N5 plan.

availableScopes.tutor:converse: Hold tutor conversations. Requires a paid plan.

availableScopes.events:write: Send events from your game or integration to Lingara.
availableScopes.embed:mint: Mint short-lived tokens for your game's or site's players, and delete players. Metered clients only.
availableScopes.embed:play: Act for a player: send their practice results and hold NPC conversations with them.
